title: How a Solar Flare Reaches Earth in Eight Minutes
description: What a solar flare is, how fast it arrives and what shields us, from NASA and NOAA.
narration: What happens when the Sun suddenly blasts out a burst of energy? A solar flare is a sudden, intense burst of radiation from the Sun. No other explosion in the solar system is more powerful. The largest have the energy of about a billion hydrogen bombs. They start when twisted magnetic fields on the Sun snap and reconnect. Its energy travels at light speed and reaches Earth in about 8 minutes. Earth's atmosphere and magnetic field shield us on the ground. Strong flares can still disrupt radio signals and affect satellites.
